items.name: file-input
items.title: File input
items.description: File selector with a button and a drop zone: multiple, accept, maxSize, a removable file list, sizes formatted with Intl, keyboard operable, drag-over state, and live-region announcements.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. The native input type=file is display:none and opened by the button, so Enter and Space work. Dropped or chosen files that do not match accept or exceed maxSize are rejected with a role=alert message. Removing a file keeps the native input's FileList in sync through DataTransfer.
